line.comment: * Heavy on performance due to FindStation:
* Company traders retain access to Pirate Bases.
* Add-Ons 1.12.3: Each case now checks currentMaxJumps, rather than having it globally initialized before.
* Mordan9 - Allow player to bump up the outpost range beyond the t-file trade distance.
* Add-Ons 1.7.4: Fixed an inversion where comparison was previously ultimatemaxjumps > maxjumps instead of maxjumps > ultimatemaxjumps.
* Add-Ons 1.12.3: Fix reachable factories setting not respecting jump range.
* Search starts narrow for performance but never exceeds configured jump range.
* Ignore docks for agents. They only trade with stations, not docks.
* AI sees everything. Player cheats a bit also, for performance reasons.
* Expanded 2.2: Account for other Traders already committed to delivering this ware.
* Trading stations can always buy and sell. Outpost Traders avoid Pirate Bases.
* station we found is good, so return it.
* station is not good, so add it to exclude list
* if we still haven't found a station, and we've expanded our search to the max distance, we're done. Otherwise,
* expand search radius and try again.
* end, while $station-> exists
* "find factory: buys" can return docks, "find factory: sells" cannot!!!
* see if anyone will buy the entire lot
* no one would buy the entire lot, so see if someone will buy 0
* Mordan2 - If no normal stations can be found within the actual gate to gate jump range limit, we can look at distant sectors with jump beacon capability.
* Mordan2 - For players, we can additionally try to find reachable player stations that are interconnected DIRECTLY by jump beacons in their 2 sectors.
* Note, this does not allow for extending the search beyond the jump beacon target system. It allows you to allow a remote system having a jump beacon to sell resources at.
* See if the trader's homebase has a beacon.
* Iterate owned sectors that have beacons
* skip this sector
* skip any sectors close by as those are handled in FindStation: already.
* write to logfile 1 append=[TRUE] printf: fmt='%s Checking %s for ware %s', $trader, $sec, $ware, null, null
* is there a beacon at this destination.
* write to logfile 1 append=[TRUE] printf: fmt='%s %s', 'Destination Beacon found in ', $beacon.destination, null, null, null
* A destination beacon does exist. Is the ware being bought at this sector?
* write to log file 1 append=[TRUE] printf: fmt='Beacon Consumer station %s FOUND for Trader %s for ware %s', $station, $trader, $ware, null, null
* write to logfile 1 append=[TRUE] printf: fmt='%s %s', 'Consumer station NOT found for trader: ', $trader, null, null, null
